Intermediate Cert Resource Delete Intermediate Ca Certificate
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/intermediateCaCertificate/:certId

Deletes the intermediate CA certificate with the specified ID. The default intermediate certificate cannot be deleted.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
certId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the intermediate CA certificate.

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
